detailed_description: The JSON Merger combines two pasted JSON values in the browser with a selected merge strategy. You can edit the JSON 1 and JSON 2 textareas, choose shallow, deep, or concat, click Merge, review an error for invalid JSON, copy the formatted output, and read the short strategy descriptions below the result. The tool calls the local mergeJsonObjects helper and is meant for quick two-input merging. It does not support more than two inputs, reordering panes, strict type checking controls, AST inspection, conflict markers, syntax-highlighted editing, array union de-duplication guarantees, or JSON file download.
usage_steps: Paste or edit the first JSON value in the JSON 1 textarea.
Paste or edit the second JSON value in the JSON 2 textarea.
Choose shallow, deep, or concat from the strategy dropdown.
Click Merge and review the output or any invalid JSON error.
Copy the formatted result when it looks useful.
usage_examples: Combine two small configuration objects while comparing shallow and deep behavior.
Merge a sample override object into a base JSON object during prototyping.
Test concat behavior for values where the local helper supports concatenation.
Copy the merged browser-side output for manual review.
